title: MIMIC-SR-ICD11: A Dataset for Narrative-Based Diagnosis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model diagnostic performance across frequent and rare disease classes (using metrics like Macro-F1 to highlight long-tail performance) and mitigating the models' tendency to overestimate a priori frequent labels by applying a Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) based re-ranking method (LL-Rank) that subtracts the unconditional prior likelihood of labels.
